mapper.select: SELECT record_id, patient_id, visit_date, doctor_name, diagnosis, treatment, notes, created_at, updated_at FROM medical_records WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY visit_date DESC

SELECT record_id, patient_id, visit_date, doctor_name, diagnosis, treatment, notes, created_at, updated_at FROM medical_records WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND visit_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY visit_date DESC
SELECT record_id, patient_id, visit_date, doctor_name, diagnosis, treatment, notes, created_at, updated_at FROM medical_records WHERE doctor_name = #{doctorName} ORDER BY visit_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medical_records (patient_id, visit_date, doctor_name, diagnosis, treatment, notes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{visitDate}, #{doctorName}, #{diagnosis}, #{treatment}, #{notes}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE medical_records SET patient_id = #{patientId}, visit_date = #{visitDate}, doctor_name = #{doctorName}, diagnosis = #{diagnosis}, treatment = #{treatment}, notes = #{notes}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
